about: What each core job costs a newcomer today, counted by the journeys in packages/E2E/Journeys (npm run test-journeys-ui): each job done in the real Dashboard or Admin Dashboard with only what is on screen, over a project made a minute ago. packages/E2E/Journeys/README.md says how each measure is counted, how to read a failure and how to add a journey.

A run fails when a measure in failOn moves from its budget, either way. Up: the job got longer - make it short again, or raise the number here and say in the pull request why the job needs it. Down: the job got shorter - lower the number here to what the run counted, so the gain is kept. The measures in reported move with copy edits: the run's table shows them beside their budget, and they never fail it.

Each journey is one path through its job. When a guided setup ships beside a manual path (#6804, #6805, #6806), its journey gets an entry of its own with path "guided", and the guided one is the headline.
Concepts met along a journey cannot be counted by a machine: the epic #6802 keeps them as a hand count.

website-monitor.title: Create a website monitor
website-monitor.endsWhen: the monitor's page opens, its probes checking the address

told-when-down.title: Make sure I am told when the monitor goes down
told-when-down.endsWhen: an on-call policy pages me for every new incident and alert

website-down-guided.title: Know when my website or API is down (guided setup)
website-down-guided.endsWhen: the monitor checks the address, an on-call policy pages me for every new incident and alert, and my test page was acknowledged

paged-by-phone.title: Get paged by phone and escalate to a teammate (Cloud)
paged-by-phone.startsAt: Home, in a new project on OneUptime Cloud
paged-by-phone.endsWhen: calls are on and paid for, my number is verified, and a policy calls me, then pages Grace

paged-by-phone-guided.title: Get paged by phone and escalate to a teammate (Cloud, guided setup)
paged-by-phone-guided.startsAt: Home, in a new project on OneUptime Cloud
paged-by-phone-guided.endsWhen: SMS and calls are on and paid for, my number is verified for both, a policy pages me for every new incident and alert, then Grace, and its test page was acknowledged

status-page.title: Publish a status page that shows the monitor
status-page.endsWhen: the status page shows the website monitor

first-telemetry.title: Send first telemetry and get an alert on it
first-telemetry.endsWhen: the first logs are in and a Logs monitor alerts on them

member-reachable.title: As an invited member, make myself reachable
member-reachable.startsAt: Home, as a member invited a minute ago, with SMS on for the project
member-reachable.endsWhen: my phone number is verified for SMS

server-email.title: As a self-hosted admin, make the server able to send email
server-email.startsAt: the Admin Dashboard, where the first admin lands (Server setup, /admin/setup)
server-email.endsWhen: the SMTP server is saved and a test email has gone out
